method: Owned disposable non-Desktop DSH Web profile booted from the 0.5.1 pre-final tarball, driven through a real Google Chrome over CDP: Settings → 技能管理 → 技能检索 → search "browser" → 查看并安装 (automatic repository review) → trust checkbox → 安装技能.
steps: The manager page opened with an empty Installed list and read-only roots made writable by using a canonical /private/tmp home (no symlinked root path).
Discover searched skills.sh and rendered real hits.
查看并安装 resolved the repository and opened the review dialog at step 3 with the resolved SKILL.md.
After checking the trust box, 安装技能 returned "已安装 agent-browser。" and closed the dialog.
The page switched to 本地技能 and filtered to "agent-browser"; the installed card is visible immediately.
cleanup: Owned Web host and Chrome stopped; the owned disposable profile home was removed and verified absent (repo test scripts only use their own owned roots).
notes: This exercises the 0.5.1 fix: before it, InstallDialog skipped the onSettled() catalog reload, so the filtered Installed list stayed empty after a repository install until a manual rescan.
The run is a scripted manual CDP session, not part of scripts/verify-hot-reenable.mjs; the automated browser evidence remains docs/verification/browser-hot-reenable-0.5.1.json.
